_comment: Maps a MyLoneWorkers SITE (the part of checkpoint.client before ' - ') to
the portal property it belongs to. Unit scans are credited by where they
happened, not by whose login did the scanning.
Names marked 'verified' were seen on real scans in Sept 2026. Sites not
listed here are matched by name (see lib/attribute.js); any site that
still cannot be matched is listed under unmatchedSites in
output/results.json so it can be added here.
